subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after_compaction hooks gain a permanent public resetSession API, and if so should the contract be current-session-only or retain the explicit-session-key compatibility overload?
rationale: Current main has no such hook API, the earlier broad reset API PR was closed unmerged, and accepting either signature creates a lasting plugin compatibility and session-authority contract.

options.title: Current-session-only API
options.body: Expose only resetSession("new" | "reset") after successful compaction and remove the unshipped explicit-key overload.

options.title: Documented compatibility overload
options.body: Keep the explicit-key form only with maintainer-approved deprecation policy, public documentation, and focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Decline the core API
options.body: Keep reset authority outside hook context and require a different owner-specific integration boundary.

recommendation.title: Current-session-only API
recommendation.body: Expose only resetSession("new" | "reset") after successful compaction and remove the unshipped explicit-key overload.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the established session reset lifecycle and a new public plugin authority boundary.
